sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A branching succulent shrub native and endemic to Tenerife in the Canary Islands. It can reach about 2 m tall, with rosettes up to 30 cm across. Its leaf margins bear fine cilia; branched inflorescences carry yellow flowers.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish food use or toxicity.
